title: Light Microcore
text: Combine an analysis crystal with four crude light cores shapelessly to obtain one light microcore, costing one crystal durability.
Analyzing sixteen crude light cores at the analysis table yields one light microcore and sixteen arcane dust.
Combine a light microcore with an analysis crystal to recover eight crude light cores, costing one durability.
Use a light microcore while aiming at shadow mist, or drop it into the cloud, to convert it to dark. Each cloud converts one microcore, then dissipates within one second.
